tasks.title: CI builds service mains and proves incident privacy across the Compose stack
tasks.spec: ## Repository: deploy, all Files/Behavior/Checks/Completion evidence; decision 12 and Rollout order step 3. E2E_SETUP defaults to full; dev selects dev/compose.yaml:e2e/compose.e2e.yaml and builds sibling checkouts through PULSE_SRC_DIR before up; any other value fails immediately. Reconcile existing checks for dev while preserving full. Add Manual incident privacy after the existing no-admin-token log check and before Probe outage, with the exact gate/skip text, four private sentinels, public control P and public marker M, and all 15 numbered steps. Marker M must be created after P's draft-update save: observe M opened, then a further successful notify poll and 3*POLL_INTERVAL settle; also observe M in proxy, feed and page before absence checks. Assert literal created/resolved counters 1/1 initially, 4/1 before api restart, 0/0 immediately after restart and 1/3 at the end. Update the overlay header for both base files without adding an e2e image line. Add a firm dev+e2e rule-5 port row in check-setup.sh and a failing regression for a port change specific to that combination. Add e2e-dev CI with the existing five-main checkout/action SHAs, persist-credentials false, init-secrets, 45-minute timeout and printed checkout revisions. Update command/CI docs. Run every check of the touched CI jobs and provide green full/dev run evidence and applicable Security impact evidence.

acceptance.expected: nonzero exit immediately with E2E_SETUP must be full or dev; no stack is started.

exit 0; both full/e2e and dev/e2e overlays obey the published-port, image, profile, networking and secrets-mount rules. The new dev+e2e port row is exactly api 127.0.0.1 3000 3000; console 127.0.0.1 8082 8082; status - 8080 8080. A deliberately changed port specific to the dev/e2e combination is rejected with rule 5. No image: line is introduced in e2e.

acceptance.command: bash e2e/outage-history.test.sh && bash e2e/metric-is.test.sh && bash e2e/manual-count.test.sh && bash e2e/published-port.test.sh && bash scripts/secrets-init.test.sh && bash scripts/bump-images.test.sh && bash scripts/wait-ready.test.sh && bash scripts/init-secrets.test.sh
acceptance.expected: exit 0; all helper/security tests of the touched lint CI job pass.
exit 0; lint/workflow checks, CLI typecheck and tests pass with the unchanged 0.8 coverage threshold.

exit 0 on the existing 0.1.0 pins; every existing step passes, including created/resolved counters 1/1 before the privacy scenario; an API gate 404 prints exactly skip: manual incident privacy (api has no /admin/manual-incidents). The default command bash e2e/compose-e2e.sh selects the same full overlay.

exit 0 with sibling service mains built before up; gate 200 runs all 15 privacy steps, whereas gate 404 fails. Auth is 401/403; draft create/edit are 201/200; internal publish is 200; draft/internal public details are 404. After the last private write, create M with legacy POST 201; observe manual::opened exactly 1 time, read notify_polls_ok, wait for a greater count and 3*POLL_INTERVAL, and observe M in proxy/feed/page before absence assertions. All four private sentinels occur 0 times on each specified public surface/channel; P has 1 update and no resolved event. Literal created/resolved metrics are 1/1 initially, 4/1 before api restart, 0/0 immediately after restart and before writes, and 1/3 finally. Restart preserves D's draft and P's note/draft update. Publishing P resolves with 2 updates, a repeat is 409, feed id manual:

:1 appears and the note stays absent. Publishing D sends opened exactly once and makes public-api down; resolving D and M succeeds; deleting draft X is 204 and private detail then 404. After notify restart, P opened/resolved, M opened and D opened each occur exactly 1 time in their specified channels; I has 0 lines in every channel. Every existing step also passes on main.
exit 0; all required CI checks complete green, including full and e2e-dev, whose timeout is 45 minutes and which prints git rev-parse HEAD for all five service checkouts.

PR links a green e2e-dev run containing the privacy ok: lines and all five image-source revisions, plus a green full run with the literal skip line. It documents the expected dev gate 404 failure against the pre-change API main SHA, all local/CI checks, and Security impact evidence: no printed tokens, existing approved action SHAs with persist-credentials false, throwaway secrets/project isolation, and unchanged common image pins. Any unrelated main drift is fixed compatibly for both modes or reported in a needs-input hold with the failing step as the spec requires.
